events.detail: Branch from origin/stage a1479e6 (after #115, the #111 branding, merged).

Plan 571d05d; stories #116-#118; 18 decisions. Cache: one DynamoDB item (ClassPhotoClassListCache-${Stage}) refreshed by EventBridge (15 min prod, 60 min elsewhere) invoking the API function; >3 h old -> live read; Neon down -> stale copy marked.

Busy indicator is native <progress> (token tests forbid animation units); submit progress = client-visible steps + elapsed seconds via XHR upload events; GITHUB_ERROR split into 'nothing was changed' vs 'submit again finishes the same PR'.
Owner: refresh once a day (not 15/60 min); cache max age ~26 h; add a 'Refresh class list' button (server: classes?refresh=1 with a ~60 s guard, phase 1; button: phase 3).

Owner: no scheduled refresh on stage (rule only on prod via IsProd; prod deploy policy only). Clean, decoupled design required: ClassListCache interface + DynamoDB implementation injected; pure freshness policy; shared service for schedule and route; in-memory fake + moto tests.

Owner changes implemented: daily cron(0 10 * * ? *) on prod only (Condition IsProd); max age 26 h; GET classes?refresh=1 with 60 s guard; ClassListCache protocol + DynamoDB impl (only boto3 importer, lazy client) + pure FreshnessPolicy + ClassListService; modules beside the function (single user).

Deploy role gains exact-name table actions CloudFormation needs (DescribeContinuousBackups etc., found via CloudTrail/registry schema) and the prod-only rule; DynamoDB client 2 s timeouts, single attempt.

Scheduled refresh retried twice by Lambda on timeout (EventInvokeConfig would need a new deploy-role action) - accepted, documented. Unconditional cache write may overwrite a newer manual refresh by one read - accepted.
Owner approved: orchestrator redeploys AsmblyFacilitiesMaintTrackingStack-cicd with AWS_PROFILE=asmbly once the #114 PR is green (after the sentinel is removed). No merge approval for #114.

Submit reads the class list via injected ClassListService; still refuses unknown class and bad file name. GITHUB_ERROR split: 'Nothing was changed on GitHub' (pre-write and all dry-run failures) vs 'Submit the same class again' (failure during writes). Logs time left before writes and write duration.
Accepted: blob/tree/commit failure moves no ref but says 'submit again' (safe). Neon down -> submit uses a cached copy of any age.

checks.node_tests: 26 scenarios pass under Node 24; skip locally without node, fail in CI without it; mutation-checked

events.detail: aria-disabled (not disabled) for Try again, Refresh and Submit-while-submitting: Chrome moves focus to body when a focused button is disabled. Submit 35 s limit from end of upload; pre-upload failure -> network message, post-upload -> unconfirmed (prod) or dry-run timeout. Script organized: apiGet/apiPost/readAnswer, updateControls single state->controls place, REFRESH_OUTCOMES Map.

Empty class list (Neon empty, nothing cached) shows no message (pre-existing); 429 on /classes shows submit wording (pre-existing); Sign out usable during submit (pre-existing); 401 after a minutes-long upload with ~60 s token left (covered by re-sign-in). Recommend a follow-up issue for the empty-list message.
Owner: 'you can merge when it's ready'. Order: PR green -> briefing -> deploy-role redeploy -> merge to stage -> watch stage deploy -> smoke test.
API README gained cache clear (delete-item) and undo steps; other docs already matched
